title: Item 6 · Undo after a change
subtitle: Mostly drift. Rule 1.4: a change that can be reversed happens at once and its toast offers Undo for 5 seconds. Color Belt, Schedule and Calendar do this. Camps' saves, Restore in Star / Black Belt / Color Belt private testing, Star's “Change how they'll pay”, Prospects' status from the panel and Forms' Close / Open don't — nobody decided that. Approved without Undo: Black Belt's Edit details and cycle saves (drawn that way), and Finance's “Day reopened” (you can close it again). (Preview screenshots · fake data · each pair is the same kind of change)

columns.note: Also without Undo today: Color Belt private testing “Changes saved”, Star “Change how they'll pay”, Forms Close / Open form, Camps “Template saved” and a camper's “Changes saved”.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · Undo after every change that can be undone

items.caption: 7. Camps' save ends like Color Belt's: “Camp saved · Undo” — and the same for every change listed on the left.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: the shared toast's Undo, which Color Belt, Schedule and Calendar already use (and item 4 already gave Edit payment). Things that can't be brought back keep asking first instead (rule 1.4). Picture 7 is a real toast with its words changed; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the same kind of change sometimes can be undone and sometimes can't — even inside one section (Prospects).
B · Recommended: rule 1.4 everywhere. Every change that can be reversed shows its Undo for 5 seconds — including Black Belt's Edit details and cycle saves (drawn without Undo but never argued). Only Finance's “Day reopened” stays as it is, because closing the day again is its undo. + one habit: “if I made a mistake, press Undo”. − small rework in Camps, Star, Black Belt, Color Belt private, Prospects, Forms.
C · Fix only the drift. Same as B, but Black Belt's approved saves keep no Undo as recorded exceptions. + doesn't reopen approved Black Belt drawings. − a mistake in Black Belt's Edit details can't be undone the way it can everywhere else.
